items.title: Leon Rene Interview, 1979-05-07
items.q: Gene Page, his father, taught me a lot.

ctx.x: Well, did you arrange a lead? A play piano? Yes.

I played piano. And then I learned how to read. One of the saxophone players with Claude Kennedy. What is the guy's name? I think the first saxophone player. In Claude Kennedy's band. Taught me how to arrange. Taught me... And taught me something. Get the scale. Know how to scale. Know what you want to put down. Use the piano for your foundation. And these are the transpositions. Here's what you do with the saxes. Here's how you have to brass. And how to score. And how to get your intervals. And so I find out how…
Well, what was the name of the band?
